risks.title: The 2025 construction start rests on a single off-site transformer that has since failed factory testing
risks.detail: Construction is treated as beginning in 2025 only because of off-site work on the custom main power transformer. On-site work did not start until January 12, 2026. That transformer failed factory acceptance testing and is being rewound. If continuity of that work or the start date were challenged, construction would begin in 2026, with two consequences. First, the domestic content threshold would rise and the 47.8% adjusted percentage, which only qualifies at the 45% threshold, would be at risk. Second, the prohibited foreign entity material assistance rules would apply, yet the module supplier certification is outstanding and no cost ratio has been prepared. Together this could cost the 10% domestic content bonus and potentially the whole credit.
